claimLines: Crash pays out at 100% RTP for your first $5,000 in wagers, dropping to 99% thereafter, giving it one of the highest RTPs available in online crash games.
No strategy eliminates the house edge, but how you manage your bankroll and cashout targets makes a real difference to how long you stay in the game and how much damage a bad run does.
The house edge compounds over time. Shorter sessions with defined limits are the most practical way to stay in control.

If you want a fast, transparent crash game with real player agency, Crash at Gamdom is a strong choice. The multi-bet format lets you run up to six strategies in a single round. For the first $5,000 in wagers, Crash carries a 100% RTP with zero house edge, dropping to 99% thereafter.

The main caveat applies to all crash games: rounds are short, the house edge is constant, and variance can be sharp. Go in with defined session limits and realistic cashout targets, and it's a fair, entertaining game. No crash game reliably delivers consistent returns.
What is the RTP of Gamdom Crash?
100% for the first $5,000 in wagers, then 99% thereafter, giving a house edge of 1% beyond the Zero Edge limit.
